description.en: Trick Eye Museum is the first and flagship Trick Eye Museum, opened in 2010 in the heart of Hongdae.

description_source.quote: Seoul Trick Eye Museum is the first and flagship Trick Eye Museum, opened in 2010 at the heart of culture and art, Hongdae in Seoul.

facts.label: Getting there
facts.value: Hongik Univ. Station (line 2, exit 9), 5 minutes on foot
facts.quote: Hongik Univ. Station (line 2, exit 9). 5 mins walk.

description.en: Hongdae Mural Street, also called Picasso Street, is one of the best places to see street art in Hongdae.
description.ko: 홍대 벽화거리(피카소 거리)는 홍대에서 스트리트 아트를 보기 좋은 곳 중 하나입니다.

description_source.quote: some of the best places to see street art in Hongdae are along Hongdae Mural Street (Picasso Street) and Fashion Street.

description.en: Hongdae Street is a lively street with street art along its benches. A Seoul Tourism information shop here has maps of Hongdae in English and many other languages.
description.ko: 홍대 거리는 벤치를 따라 스트리트 아트가 이어지는 활기찬 거리입니다. 이곳의 서울관광 안내소에서는 영어를 비롯한 여러 언어의 홍대 지도를 얻을 수 있습니다.

description_source.quote: There is also a nice selection of street art along the benches in Hongdae Street

facts.label: Tourist information
facts.value: A Seoul Tourism information shop on the street has maps of Hongdae in English
facts.quote: You can find a helpful Seoul Tourism tourist information shop here too which has maps of Hongdae in English plus many other languages.

description.en: Olive Young is a hub for Korean skincare and beauty brands, like a Korean Sephora. There are outlets in Hongdae where you can pick up K-beauty gifts.
description.ko: 올리브영은 한국 스킨케어와 뷰티 브랜드가 모여 있는 곳으로, 한국의 세포라와 비슷합니다. 홍대에도 매장이 있어 K-뷰티 선물을 사기 좋습니다.

description_source.quote: Akin to Sephora and Ulta, Olive Young is a hub for Korean skincare and beauty brands.

description.en: Kyochon is a Korean fried chicken restaurant chain. Its menu includes soy sauce chicken, red sauce chicken and honey glazed chicken.
description.ko: 교촌은 한국의 프라이드치킨 레스토랑 체인입니다. 간장치킨, 레드소스치킨, 허니치킨 등이 메뉴에 있습니다.

description_source.quote: Products: Fried Chicken, Korean Fried Chicken, Soy Sauce Chicken, Red Sauce Chicken, Honey Glazed Chicken
